text:
nina_csm: BeaconWorks weekly check-in  flagged a noticeable uptick in errors this morning during their nightly doc index. Concerned about renewal if SLA noise continues.
ryan_ops: rolled 24h and 1h views: overall error-rate jumped to 2.9% from 0.6% last week. Breakdown (24h): 5xx: 2.0%, timeouts: 0.6%, rate-limit: 0.3%. Most traffic concentrated in a few paths.
zara_se: owning triage  I replayed failed traces: majority of 5xx are 502/503 from model backend, and a subset are OOMs on sequences > 6k. We also have increased client-side retry storms hitting `/v1/embeddings/bulk`.
ryan_ops: top offenders last 24h:
- `/v1/complete` 5xx 2.8% / timeout 0.5%
- `/v1/chat/stream` timeout 1.1% / 5xx 1.5%
- `/v1/embeddings/bulk` rate-limit 1.9% / timeout 2.4% (clients retrying)
- `/v1/files/upload` timeout 1.7% (s3 upstream slow)
nina_csm: BeaconWorks reported nightly job that sends 10k docs in one burst. That explains `/v1/embeddings/bulk` pressure and downstream retries. Their usage trend also shows 18% drop overall, which we should call out in renewal packet.
zara_se: immediate mitigations I recommend: 1) rollback the canary quantized variant (rolled yesterday) for their traffic only, 2) enable short-circuit for requests > 6k tokens to return 4xx with guidance, 3) temporary client-side token bucket for `/embeddings/bulk`.
ryan_ops: infra actions: spin up 1 extra Dedicated GPU for BeaconWorks pool (+short burst), enable KV prefix cache for chat routes, and apply rate-limit smoothing at the edge for bulk endpoints.
infra_bot: [alert] BeaconWorks: Error surge detected 2026-03-20T07:08Z -> id: B-4422, status: investigating, pools: dedicated-eu-west-1.
zara_se: diagnostics snippet from failing trace:
```
TRACE ID: bw-3f9d
backend_error: RuntimeOOM
seq_len: 7124
model_variant: small-quant-canary
```
nina_csm: customer asks for quick win we can promise in renewal call: reduce visible errors by EOD. Leo on their side will stagger jobs and throttle batch size to 500. Tom, can you send the recommended config? @tom_csm
tom_csm: will draft and send within 30m. Also adding a 1-page error trend chart for execs.
zara_se: I'll do the rollback to stable for BeaconWorks traffic only in the next 10m and re-run smoke.
ryan_ops: provisioning extra GPU now, toggling edge smoothing rules. Ill post new metrics in ~20m: https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/BeaconWorks-errors
nina_csm: action items: 1) zara -> targeted rollback + smoke (10m), 2) ryan -> provision burst GPU + edge smoothing, 3) tom -> customer config + batch throttle email, 4) nina -> update renewal risk if errors persist after 24h.
tom_csm: noted  will coordinate with their SRE to confirm roll schedule and get time windows.
ryan_ops: quick note  if errors < 1% after mitigations we mark as low renewal risk; otherwise escalate to account execs.
nina_csm: thanks all. Reconvene if anything changes; otherwise, I'll post a summary for the renewal packet tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
